items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Just glad to meet you, glad to meet you, Kaiser. I was sure looking forward to this. I was standing there on the dance floor (crowded), so I was happy to meet him, anybody, you know, man like him, Kaiser Marshall.

ctx.x: Okay. Now, do you remember when -- oh, since we're on the subject of sock cymbal --
Kaiser Marshall, to me, first one I saw play a high hat cymbal.
